scope: Observed OS process working set/high-water counter, including startup; not GPU memory or an exact continuous peak.

gpu_memory.scope: Local WDDM per-process adapter counters, summed once per unique instance; dedicated+shared and total committed are separate measures. Sampled/provider-refreshed observations, not an exact continuous peak, global device usage or an uninstrumented timing run. CIM operation timeout is not a hard OS deadline.
